Previously, India had halted wheat exports in July 2022 due to rising local prices. Global price skyrocketed when the Russia-Ukraine conflict had impacted wheat trade significantly. The government had previously set a 5 million tonne export limit earlier this year.

An automated facility for export obligation extensions was also introduced by the DGFT.
